To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the dissemination of Education Policy 6 in the KwaZulul Natal Department of Education was a top-down process that was not well coordinated and did not take into account the views of teachers and other stakeholders.
the dissemination of Education WP 6 on inclusive education is a complex and challenging task.
teachers in our sample had limited understandings of the concept of inclusive and special needs education and that they were generally not ready to implement inclusive education in their classrooms.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the nature of teachers'understandings about the policy and the innovation, the factors that impact upon their understandings, and the nature of support that the Department of Education provides to teachers to enable them to implement inclusive education in their classrooms.
how teachers make sense of inclusive education policy and the concept, how the policy is diffused and how teachers are prepared to implement the innovation in their classrooms and in their schools.

how teachers in three primary schools in two districts of the province have understood and experienced the policy and concept, how the province has diffused the policy, and the nature and quality of support provided by its sub-systems and schools in the preparation of teachers for the implementation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the study found that the KwaZuIu-Natal Department of education has adopted a complex and multifaceted approach in the dissemination and support of teachers to implement inclusive education in schools.
the teachers in this study have not yet understood the policy or concept of inclusive education and that the province has not yet prepared or supported them to implement the policy.
the KwaZu-lu Natal Department of Education has not adequately prepared teachers to implement inclusive education in schools.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

teachers'understandings are influenced by their experiences, the support they receive from the KwaZulunatal Department of Education, the districts and the schools, their own beliefs about the nature of disability and the nature and purpose of schooling.
the teachers in this study were aware of the policy, and were aware of the need to implement inclusive education in schools.
the study revealed a complex picture of the dissemination of the policy and preparation of schools for its implementation in the two districts and the three schools.

the province has not been successful in preparing and supporting schools to implement inclusive education in the schools.
